From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: procurement sequencing & pilot close timeline (Medixio)

Alicia —

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is an updated mutual action plan (MAP_Medixio_v2.xlsx) that sequences evaluation milestones alongside the procurement/legal gates we typically see (MSA, DPA, order form). I tried to align the milestones to the windows your team mentioned — 6 week technical eval -> legal review -> signature target.

Two asks to keep this moving:
- Can your procurement contact confirm the ordering authority and whether a standard PO will be used or if you require a completed order form + signature?
- If you can share any must-have contract language (e.g., data residency, audit windows) we’ll flag those up front.

I looped in Karthik for a quick DPA sanity check and Markus for procurement handoff logistics. I’ve also included a draft order form and a DPA matrix for our internal redlines.

Attachments: MAP_Medixio_v2.xlsx, orderform_draft.pdf, DPA_matrix_redwood.xlsx

Proposed next steps (in MAP):
- Week 1: finalize eval plan + test data access (owner: Medixio / Tom)
- Week 2–3: technical validation & performance checkpoints (owner: Medixio / Redwood engs)
- Week 4: procurement packets + DPA review (owner: Medixio procurement + Redwood legal)
- Week 5–6: signature & onboarding prep (target close)

If that cadence looks off on your side, tell me which dates to move and we’ll rebase.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Sr. Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: procurement sequencing & pilot close timeline (Medixio)

Evelyn —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear timeline. This is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement:

- We typically issue a PO for pilots under $50k, but for anything beyond that we need a signed order form plus countersigned MSA/DPA.
- Primary procurement contact is procurement@medixio.com (copied). Please include PO flow and any fiscal contact fields on the order form.
- We do have a short procurement questionnaire; I attached it (procurement_questionnaire_Medixio.pdf). Can you fill the procurement fields and return by end of this week?

On legal specifics: data residency is US-only (no cross-border storage for PHI-derived artifacts), and we’ll likely ask for a 30-day data deletion SLA post-pilot. I’ll confirm exact language.

Timelines: your proposed 5–6 week close seems doable, but I need to check internal legal capacity. I’ll loop Tom (our technical lead) to confirm the Week 2–3 checkpoints.

Alicia
Alicia Ramos | Head of Partnerships
Medixio Health
alicia.ramos@medixio.com

(attachment: procurement_questionnaire_Medixio.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medixio.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: procurement sequencing & pilot close timeline (Medixio)

Alicia / Evelyn —

Quick follow-up from legal/ops perspective after a glance at the DPA items Alicia mentioned. A few clarifications that will materially affect sequencing:

1) If Medixio requires US-only residency AND a 30-day deletion SLA, we can support that but it impacts the DPA review cycle (we’ll need SCG and engineering signoff on retention/deletion runbooks). That makes legal review closer to 7–10 business days once the DPA draft is in.

2) Order form vs PO: if procurement plans to issue a PO, we can accept it, but signatures (MSA + DPA + order form) will be required for contract completeness for pilots >$50k. If you plan to use PO only, please confirm the PO approval chain and attach a sample PO.

3) I attached a compact DPA_matrix_redwood.xlsx highlighting the clauses that typically create iteration cycles (data access scopes, third-party subprocessors, audit windows). If Medixio flags any of the marked clauses as must-change, call that out in your return and we’ll pre-annotate concessions.

Proposed sequencing update (to set expectations):
- Day 0–7: finalize technical eval and return procurement questionnaire (owner: Medixio)
- Day 7–14: Redwood legal issues initial DPA/Order form redline (owner: Redwood legal)
- Day 14–24: Medixio legal review & comment (owner: Medixio legal)
- Day 24–30+: Signatures and PO issuance (owner: Medixio procurement + Redwood commercial)

If you think Medixio legal can accelerate review to under a week, we can compress. Otherwise assume ~3–4 week contract cycle after DPA exchange.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Ops (Contracts)
Redwood Inference
(attachment: DPA_matrix_redwood.xlsx)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medixio.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: procurement sequencing & pilot close timeline (Medixio)

Alicia —

Appreciate the quick reply and the procurement questionnaire. I filled the commercial fields and uploaded the map with the updated owners. Attached: MAP_Medixio_v2.xlsx (updated), orderform_draft.pdf (minor fiscal fields populated).

Concrete next actions from Redwood:
- I’ll send the populated procurement questionnaire back by EOD (owner: Evelyn) — expect that in your inbox within 3 hours.
- Karthik will push initial DPA redlines to you by Friday so Medixio legal has something to react to (owner: Karthik).
- Markus will prep a short PO acceptance checklist and sample PO fields for your procurement team (owner: Markus).
- Laura (copied) will schedule a 30-minute legal sync with your counsel if you prefer a live walkthrough of the DPA redlines (owner: Laura).

Target close: we’ll tentatively map signatures for Week 6 in the MAP but will move earlier if legal alignment goes faster. I’ve added a DocuSign draft link to the MAP for visibility.

If Medixio can confirm the PO flow and return the questionnaire today, we’ll keep the 5–6 week target. Otherwise we’ll update the MAP to reflect the slightly longer legal cadence Karthik described.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this pilot.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Sr. Account Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachments: MAP_Medixio_v2.xlsx, orderform_draft.pdf)
